text: これでは　たたかえません！

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: Changing the last sound of たたかう to え makes the 'can' form, here made polite and negative. たたかえません = 'cannot battle'.

patterns.name: 〜では
patterns.explanation: では after a thing means 'with things this way', usually before something bad. これでは = 'like this'.
